title: Restore typed broadcaster mailbox capacity-eviction regression tests
outcome: The retained capacity-256 drop-oldest policy has typed tests for delta and snapshot eviction and nonblocking publication.
acceptance: A publisher on another thread returns while the mailbox is full, proving the retained capacity policy does not wait for draining.
Typed mailbox tests exercise overflow beyond capacity for oldest-delta eviction, snapshot eviction of an oldest delta, and delta eviction of an oldest snapshot, asserting retained revision order.
